metadata.description: Run a crew of coding agents in Herdr panes, managed by one lead agent.

plugins.name: crew-up
plugins.description: Start, configure and manage a crew of coding agents (Claude, Hermes, ...) in Herdr panes: roster with on/off members, per-member backend (Anthropic, MindRouter, local), role cards, and the manager's playbook.

plugins.name: paren-repair
plugins.description: Optional: fix mismatched Clojure delimiters on every Write/Edit via clojure-mcp-light's clj-paren-repair-claude-hook (only does anything if that tool is installed).
